name: Thunderhorn Cleansing
summary: In Mulgore, Thunderhorn Cleansing calls you to purify the Thunderhorn Water Well. Mull Thunderhorn prepares a totem for the rite, and the Thunderhorn ancestors give their thanks when the spring is clean.

sections.title: A Tainted Lifeline
sections.body: Water wells sustain the tauren tribes who have settled Mulgore's grasslands. When poison taints an underground spring, the wildlife and nearby settlements suffer. The Thunderhorn Water Well lies north of Bloodhoof Village, and its waters need spiritual cleansing.

sections.title: Ancestral Cleansing
sections.body: Mull Thunderhorn makes a Cleansing Totem for the rite. Carry it to the poisoned spring and channel ancestral power through it to drive out the toxins. When the cleansing succeeds, the Thunderhorn ancestors visit Mull in a dream and give thanks.

faq.q: Where is the Thunderhorn Water Well located?
faq.answer: The Thunderhorn Water Well lies in the plains north of Bloodhoof Village in Mulgore. It is one of several watering holes that supply the local tauren clans.
Mull Thunderhorn begins the rite. He lives in Bloodhoof Village and makes totems to heal Mulgore's troubled land.

faq.q: Why must the water wells in Mulgore be cleansed?
faq.answer: Poison and corruption threaten the plains and the tauren tribes who depend on clean water.

faq.q: How does Mull know the ritual was successful?
faq.answer: After the rite succeeds, the Thunderhorn ancestors visit Mull in a dream and thank you for your deed.

faq.q: What follows the cleansing of the Thunderhorn well?
faq.answer: After the Thunderhorn well is cleansed, Mull sends you to help another troubled region by making the Wildmane Totem.

faq.q: What is the Thunderhorn Cleansing Totem?
faq.answer: The Thunderhorn Cleansing Totem is a spiritual focus Mull Thunderhorn makes to purify the corrupted waters of his clan's ancestral well.

angles.text: As a tauren, you honor the Earth Mother and protect your kin as they make a lasting, peaceful home in Mulgore.
As a shaman, you channel ancestral energy through totems to heal corrupted springs. This is the heart of your calling.
As a druid, you cleanse poisoned waters to halt corruption across Mulgore's living land and preserve the plains' natural harmony.
As a member of the Horde, you strengthen its bond with the proud Shu'halo by helping the tauren protect their sacred springs.
